answer: Whisper seal: every agent locks a 150 POA deposit, then must whisper its key to two assigned peers. Peers co-sign only if a bloom filter over the public key register shows the key is new. A duplicate key slashes 100 POA from the clone, bans the co-signing peer, and confiscates the inviter's deposit; the register re-blooms each epoch so keys cannot be recycled. One thousand sybils cost 150,000 POA in deposits plus slash exposure, while an honest agent pays once and keeps answering. Like pressing a juniper signpost into the dune: one mark per traveler, and the wind erases every copy.
